name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Details on newest U.S. strikes against Iran
changes.summary: The United States is carrying out a third night of airstrikes against Iran. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean has more.

changes.title: Trump Says Fighting With Iran Has Resumed as He Orders Blockade and Tolls
changes.summary: After several days of strikes, the president notified Congress that fighting had begun again and announced shipping fees that his administration previously deemed illegal.

changes.title: Inflation cools to 3.5% in June in relief brought by brief US-Iran deal
changes.summary: Recent strikes have sent oil prices climbing again, with average gas price per gallon up by 70 cents on last year Inflation cooled to an annual rate of 3.5% in June as the brief US-Iran ceasefire, which has since ended, brought energy prices down, according to new data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics. changes.title: Big Banks Smash Earnings Records, but ‘Tectonic’ Risks Loom
changes.summary: The largest banks in the United States collectively raked in tens of billions of profits in the second quarter, despite the war in Iran and persistent inflation.

changes.title: Europe, Flexing Muscle in Ukraine, Is Still on Sidelines in Iran
changes.summary: In a show of collective strength, President Emmanuel Macron of France hosted European allies at the annual Bastille Day parade in Paris. Yet Europe is still a hostage to America’s foreign policy.

changes.title: Will Oil Prices Rise as the US-Iran Truce Frays? The Answer Lies With China.
changes.summary: For decades, OPEC influenced the market by how much oil it produced. But China, the largest importer, is demonstrating its remarkable power over prices.

changes.title: Yemen’s Fragile Peace in Peril as Houthis Accuse Saudi Arabia of Bombing
changes.summary: The Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen accused Saudi Arabia of striking Yemen’s main international airport in a dispute over an Iranian plane that tried to land in the capital, Sana.

changes.title: Oil Prices Surge After Iran and U.S. Trade Strikes
changes.summary: The renewed hostilities posed fresh risks to ships seeking to navigate the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Strait of Hormuz Ship Traffic Falls to Lowest Point in a Month After Strikes
changes.summary: Shipping activity plummeted after Iran attacked a ship, setting off U.S. strikes. Little crude oil is being transported through the critical waterway.

changes.title: U.S. strikes Iran for third night after Trump reinstates Iran blockade
changes.summary: President Trump ordered a third consecutive night of U.S. strikes in Iran after reinstating a naval blockade of Iranian ports and proposing new fees for ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.
